deviations.description: Run verify-sapience-context-scoping.sh live from this repository and record its outcome
deviations.reason: Live sampling during this phase surfaced a real correctness defect in the Phase-2-shipped probe: it used two FIXED literal session_id strings on every invocation, and the vault's own server-side repeat/novelty suppression (status.overnight: 'N repeats hidden') accumulates against a reused session_id across repeated runs, which can make the two calls' responses differ for a reason that has nothing to do with the project= field under test -- a false RESIDUAL_LIFTED. Fixed by minting a unique session_id per invocation (pid+epoch). This reduced but did not eliminate the noise (the suppression is not purely session-scoped); the script's own header and RESIDUAL_LIFTED wording were updated to say so explicitly, so a future reader is told to re-sample rather than conclude the vendor ask landed from one run. Final official evidence used the majority outcome across 4 fresh-session runs (3 RESIDUAL_HOLDS, 1 RESIDUAL_LIFTED attributable to the documented caveat) plus a clean --print capture with non-empty delivered content.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — fixed a session_id-reuse correctness defect in the Phase 2 script discovered during live Phase 4 sampling; redeployed and re-verified)*

notes: Acceptance-criteria evidence: verify-sapience-context-scoping.sh --print (deployed, fixed version) returned RESIDUAL_HOLDS with a non-empty text block (1 rule, 2 facts) on a fresh session, confirming both that project= remains ignored on POST /v1/cli/context and that the channel still delivers content (criteria 1 and 2). Deployed mirror confirmed present: .claude/context/project/sapience/domain/injection-site-scoping.md exists, index.json carries exactly one matching entry. settings-fragment.json and sapience-retrieve.sh diffs against HEAD are empty -- no hook, grant, or retrieval path was touched by this task.
